name: agentflow
description: A spec-to-ship pipeline for coding agents: auto-triggering skills enforce spec, plan, task contracts, TDD, and severity-gated review. One manifest compiles to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any AGENTS.md harness. A committed ledger survives context compaction. Zero telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Enforces spec → plan → task contracts → TDD → review for any coding agent; compiles from one manifest
interface.longDescription: Agentflow turns 'start coding' into a signed-off pipeline: an analyst-drawn spec, an architect's plan, machine-checkable task contracts (done-when, stop-if), TDD execution with per-task evidence, severity-gated code review, and an integration menu at the end. A git-committed ledger records every gate, ruling, and completion — a fresh session, or one that just went through compaction, resumes exactly where the last one died: no repeated work, no lost decisions. Installs as a Claude Code / Codex / Cursor plugin or rides on AGENTS.md anywhere. Zero telemetry, MIT.
